Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring child fatality reviews for children involved in the child welfare system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to child fatality reviews for children involved inthe child welfare system; and adding a new section to chapter 74.13RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of social and health services shall conduct achild fatality review in the event of a death from any cause of achild: Who is in outofhome care at the time of the child's death; orwho had been reunified with the child's family at the time of thechild's death following a placement in outofhome care. (2) Upon conclusion of a child fatality review required pursuant tosubsection (1) of this section, the department shall issue a report onthe results of the review.
